messages:
Maya: quick ask — can someone run a tinybatch throughput smoke on staging-rt with max_tokens=512? I want to validate the recent queue preemption tweak before tomorrow's deploy.

Jeff: I can do it in ~30m. Any preferred loadgen profile? small payloads, 1-2 concurrent clients?

Sam: use loadgen profile 'tinyburst' — it mimics bursty PLG traffic. start with concurrency=4, qps=100 then ramp.

Tara: also set batch_size_max=8 and cb_window_ms=8 for the run. capture kv-cache hit metrics.

Maya: exactly. capture p50/p95 latency, tokens/s, and 'cb_queue_len' histogram. tag it with run_id=surgeprobe-29765

Jeff: copying command —

Jeff: ```./loadgen --profile tinyburst --concurrency 4 --qps 100 --run-id surgeprobe-29765 --model rdlw-7b --max-tokens 512 --batch-max 8 --cb-window-ms 8```

CI-bot: scheduled job https://ci.redwood.com/job/bench/29765 started by @Jeff

Jeff: running now. will post results + flamegraph link.

Jeff: results: p50=18ms, p95=120ms, tokens/s=42000, avg_batch=3.2, cb_queue_len mean=1.1. No OOMs. Attaching perf snippet.

Jeff: ```RESULT: p50=18ms p95=120ms throughput=42k tokens/s avg_batch=3.2 queues=[0:78%,1:20%,2+:2%]```

Sam: those p95s are higher than last week's baseline (p95~80ms). Did queue preemption kick in?

Tara: check traces — if preemption happened you'd see a short spike at queue handoff. Can you upload trace id?

Jeff: trace_id=trc-00029765 => https://traces.redwood.com/trc-00029765 — looks like a 2-request stall during a short GC in kv cache but not huge.

Maya: thanks. Action: Jeff to re-run with cb_window_ms=12 and batch_max=6; Sam to run a microprofile capturing kernel selection logs; Tara to open a tiny follow-up CR if tuning helps.

Jeff: re-running now with updated params. will ping when done.

Jeff: second run done: p50=16ms p95=95ms throughput=39k tokens/s avg_batch=2.8. p95 improved but tokens/s dropped ~7%.

Sam: tradeoff looks acceptable for our p95 SLO. Note: please add the run metadata to /perf/mini_runs spreadsheet.

Maya: agreed. If no regression in other models we'll ship preemption tweak. Thanks all :thumbsup:
